C0825.title: Linyi Alert on Multiple Impersonation Scams Targeting Officials
C0825.summary: In June 2021, Linyi's Lanshan District recorded 13 telecom fraud cases involving scammers impersonating Party and government officials. Fraudsters used WeChat to mass-add staff, built trust by feigning concern about work, and then requested urgent fund transfers to trick victims into wiring money.

references.title: Police Urgent Alert! Multiple Boss Impersonation Scams in Linyi Recently
